class: A reviewer demands a walk of a new plan while every observed conclusion stays the same; the review must re-key on the new demand, and a receipt for the old demand must not satisfy it.
notes: Order: (1) walk-1790943778… (old plan) offered for the demand made by the round-6 review (packet-1524-…, the new plan in walk-1790945582…) does not apply (registered); (2) the new demand gets its own evidence attempt, walk-1790945582…; (3) the successor review's key changes although the conclusions are equal, because the demand key is an input; (4) counter-case: walk-1790902623… and walk-1790943778… walk the same plan with equal conclusions, so no re-review. Reasons 2–4 are proposed. In (4) the grant digests differ (a grant rebind); reuse equivalence compares subject, demand, instrument digest and restrictions, so this holds only if the rebind changed none of them.
